format_status: New durable record format because no dedicated cross-era review schema/path/tool was present at production base; existing per-sheet review convention is reused under the later-era reviews directory. No tooling/CI contract is changed by this record.

methodology.unit: complete matching role sets, not independent sheet approvals
methodology.source_rule: Only exact Drive originals listed in the two reference-set.json files were downloaded and locally reverified before visual comparison.
methodology.blind_order: Era names, years, filenames and metadata were hidden behind Set A/Set B for each role until an earlier→later order was judged from physical construction/technology; A/B mapping was revealed only afterward.

preserved: metal stock, structural members and visible fastening remain readable
replaced: rough one-off welded/patch construction and irregular joints
with repeatable pressed/folded panels, cold-formed profiles, standardized fasteners, brackets, hatches, grilles and louvers
added: factory-repeatable profiled sheet and service-panel families
materials-construction.why: The physical language changes from one-off garage fabrication to repeatable workshop manufacturing.
materials-construction.player_signal: Repeated folds/profile sections, regular bolt patterns and modular service hardware read as later industrial production.
materials-construction.physical_replacement: Rough welded patch/gusset/angle assemblies are replaced by folded/profiled sections and repeatable bolted service-panel/bracket hardware.

preserved: visible serviceable shafts, bearings, joints, lifting points and utility connections
replaced: open manual gears/chains/belts/screws, hand winches and improvised cable/pipe routing
with electric motors/gearboxes, hydraulic cylinders, guarded transmissions, standardized bearings/handling units, cable trays/clamps/unions and manifolds
added: repeatable cable/pipe routing hardware and manifold blocks
mechanics-infrastructure.why: Workshop throughput and repeatability require assisted drives and standardized infrastructure instead of hand-operated one-off mechanisms.
mechanics-infrastructure.player_signal: Motors/cylinders, guards and organized trays/manifolds make the later set read as assisted industrial machinery.
mechanics-infrastructure.physical_replacement: Hand-cranked screw/winch and exposed belt/chain drive language is replaced by motor/gearbox and hydraulic-cylinder drive units with functional guards.

preserved: analog instrumentation remains part of the operator language
replaced: individually fitted toggles/levers/handwheel and disparate one-off instrument housings
with standardized pushbutton/selector/key-switch families, grouped stations, matching gauge modules and standardized service electronics/connectors
added: standardized connector bank and consistent deep CRT housings where applicable
controls-displays.why: Repeatable operating and maintenance procedures require interchangeable control families and grouped modules.
controls-displays.player_signal: Repeated bezels, matching gauge families and grouped service/status modules distinguish the later interface without relying on element count or color.
controls-displays.physical_replacement: A one-off toggle/lever faceplate family is replaced by repeatable industrial pushbutton/selector hardware and a grouped multi-button station on standardized housings.

preserved: physical work-light and signal hardware remains visible and serviceable
replaced: bare/incandescent bulb, pendant/caged work-light and larger individual ad-hoc signal fittings
with enclosed fluorescent/bulkhead/task fixtures and repeatable modular indicator, beacon, stack-light and rectangular signal families
added: stack-light and matched rectangular signal modules
lighting-signals.why: A planned workshop needs consistent area/task lighting and reusable signal standards rather than isolated individual fittings.
lighting-signals.player_signal: Repeated fixture housings and matched signal families read as planned factory lighting/signaling, not simply more lamps or brighter colors.
lighting-signals.physical_replacement: Bare/caged incandescent and pendant fixtures are replaced by enclosed fluorescent/bulkhead units, while isolated signal lamps become repeatable modular R/A/G and stack-light families.

approval_effect: E0 and E1 may be marked approved_visual_reference_set and required canonical references.
next_step: E2 / 1998 atomic reference rebuild against approved E1 lineage
